C0058.title: Pinduoduo System Vulnerability Exploited for Nearly 10 Million Yuan
C0058.summary: In early 2019, a system vulnerability on Pinduoduo allowed users to claim 100-yuan no-threshold coupons for free. Coupon hunters quickly spread the news via social platforms, leading to nearly 10 million yuan being exploited overnight, demonstrating how groups exploit loopholes in platform marketing campaigns for large-scale arbitrage.

references.title: The evolution of wool-pullers: gold diggers on the flip side of the internet-Huxiu Net
